serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I wonder what this is about…
Lady Annalie: I’m sorry to bring up this topic on such an important day, but I wouldn't want to leave any uncertainties behind in this city.
Lady Annalie: It’s about Melissa. {{wi}}Is she really alright?
You: W-What do you mean?
Did she figure out that Melissa is gone? How?
Lady Annalie: You see, I had a bad feeling the day she texted me that she was leaving. 
Lady Annalie: I wanted to ignore it, but I just couldn’t shake it off. 
Lady Annalie: The messages from her kept coming, I thought I was just being paranoid from loneliness, but…
Lady Annalie: I just feel like something is not right.
Lady Annalie: She rarely answers to my texts now, and it feels like she wants to brush me off, which only makes my uneasiness grow bigger.
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Pervy+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Hmm
Lady Annalie: That’s why I want to ask you. {{wi}}Please. Is she alright?
What am I supposed to answer…
The longer I wait the harder it gets for words to get out of my mouth…
You: I’m sorry.{{wi}} She’s… dead…
Lady Annalie: …
Lady Annalie: Was it painful? 
You: I don’t think so…
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.SmileClosed+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Normal
Lady Annalie: I see, thank you for telling me.
You: Y-You won’t ask any other questions?! How did it happen? Why…
Lady Annalie: I think I know, more or less. Deep down, I have known for a long time.
You: Aren’t you suspecting me?! Blaming me for it?!
#Annalie_Outside.face.smileEyeClosed
Lady Annalie: Don’t worry. This whole setup. It just screams Melissa. 
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.SmileClosed+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Normal
Lady Annalie: Could you give me some time? I will join you later. I don’t want {f_botName} to see me cry.
You: Sure…
